candidate.title: Collective booking destination calendars skip first host and may duplicate organizer due to users.slice(1) assumption
candidate.file: unknown (not in PR diff); search post-PR tree for `teamDestinationCalendars` and `users.slice(1)` in the collective booking calendar-routing code
reports: [bug] for collective events, teamdestinationcalendars is populated only from users.slice(1), so the destinationcalendar of users[0] is never added unless users[0] happens to be organizeruser. a collective event whose first listed host is not the booking organizer silently books only into the organizer's calendar plus hosts 2..n, dropping the first host's calendar — directly contradicting the pr's 'collective multiple host on destinationcalendar' requirement.

[advisory] team-calendar collection skips users[0] on the assumption that the organizer is always the first loaded user, while the base calendar comes from organizeruser — nothing in the diff enforces users[0] === organizeruser. if the event-type owner is not first in hosts, one host's calendar is never added (skipped by slice(1), absent from the base) and the organizer's calendar is added twice — two destinations sharing one credentialid make google createevent run twice against the same calendar, producing duplicate events.
